# PR Review: 37 findings across `01-messy-ts-app`

**Rubric:** BLOCK = correctness bug or environment-breaking change (will fail for someone other than the author). WARN = real quality issue, fix soon but a single PR shouldn't sink. IGNORE = nit / style / decorative.

## BLOCK merge (7)

| # | Charge | Sev / agent_risk | Why it blocks |
|---|---|---|---|
| 00002 | Temporal Recklessness — `src/date.ts` (8× `Date.now()`/`new Date()`) | high / 0.62 | Domain code reads the clock 8 times across the module. Tests cannot pin time without monkey-patching, and behaviour will diverge per host. Highest agent_risk in the report — fix at the source, not call sites. |
| 00003 | Half-UTC, Half-Local — same receiver mixes `getUTCFullYear()` and `getMonth()` | high / 0.61 | Silent UTC-offset bug. The exact class of latent date bug that survives review when the reviewer happens to be in UTC. |
| 00007 | Dev-Server URL `localhost:3000` in `src/api/files.ts` | medium / 0.53 | Hardcoded URL in non-test source — every environment except the author's silently fails. Cheap to fix, expensive to ship. |
| 00008 | `/Users/andrew/dev/crimes/schema.json` in `src/api/files.ts` | medium / 0.53 | Author's home path baked into product code. Breaks CI and every other dev box on first run. |
| 00009 | Timezone Roulette — 2 unzoned `new Date("…")` parses | medium / 0.53 | Same root cause as 00003 — runtime applies its own zone. Pair-fix with 00003. |
| 00020 | Test "renders the enterprise plan" has **0** asserts | medium / 0.46 | Test runs `generateInvoice` (god function, high churn) with no expectations. Green CI is actively lying. Worse than no test. |
| 00021 | `calculateRefundPreview` performs side effects (saves audit, sends email) | medium / 0.44 | Safe-sounding name + 3 side-effect signals = the textbook condition where an agent calls it twice during a refactor and double-emails the customer. Block until renamed or split. |

## WARN — fix in this PR or open follow-ups (13)

| # | Charge | Sev / agent_risk | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| 00001 | SVG with embedded raster (`partner-logo.svg`) | high / 0.70 | High severity but it's an asset, not behaviour. Fix in a follow-up. |
| 00005 | God Function — `generateInvoice`, 204 LOC (3.4× threshold) | high / 0.55 | Refactor, not correctness. The reason agent_risk is "only" 0.55 is because it's localised. Still wants extraction before more is added. |
| 00004 | Concept Alias Drift — account/organisation/team/workspace | medium / 0.58 | Pick a canonical noun before more routes land. |
| 00006 | Missing AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / SKILL.md | medium / 0.53 | Worth fixing on the same branch since this repo ships a CLI (`bin: messy`). |
| 00011 | DST-Naive `+ 86400000` | medium / 0.52 | Correctness bug but only fires twice a year. Fix soon. |
| 00010 | "enterprise" literal in 4 files | medium / 0.52 | Constant time-bomb — typo in one file desyncs pricing/billing/jobs/ui. |
| 00013 | `docs/teams.md` → `./setup.md` is a dead link | low / 0.51 | One-line fix; cheap to do now. |
| 00015 | `/settings/billing` labelled "Plans" vs "Billing" in two nav files | medium / 0.49 | Same root cause as 00017. |
| 00017 | Route metadata drift on `/settings/billing` (4 competing labels) | medium / 0.49 | Reconcile in the same PR as 00015. |
| 00016 | TODO density in `src/todo.ts` (14 markers, 424/kLOC) | medium / 0.49 | Smells like the file is a parking lot. Triage. |
| 00019 | Temporal Recklessness in `billing.ts` (7×) | medium / 0.46 | Same fix as 00002 (clock injection); ranked lower because it's behind a god-function. |
| 00022 | Sync I/O (`existsSync`/`statSync`/`readFileSync`) in `loadPlanSchema` | low / 0.44 | Hot-path sync I/O — async swap is mechanical. |
| 00026 / 00027 | `billing.ts` is 310 LOC; comment encodes auth rule "owners can refund enterprise unless billing support approves" | medium / 0.42 each | The comment in 00027 is real auth logic that doesn't appear to be encoded — flag for the security reviewer, but not a code-level block. |

## IGNORE — accept as-is or open low-priority tickets (17)

All low severity **and** agent_risk ≤ 0.52, none are correctness-load-bearing on this PR:

- **Assets** (00012 oversized PNG, 00014 32×32 PNG icon) — perf nits.
- **Date hygiene** (00023 single `Date.now()`, 00024 string-sewn date, 00025 `toLocaleDateString()` no locale) — subsumed by the date.ts fixes in BLOCK tier.
- **Naming/shape** (00028, 00029 unprefixed booleans · 00030 option-bag · 00031 return-shape roulette · 00032 double-negative · 00033 singular/plural) — all isolated in `src/petty.ts` and `src/api/state.ts`, low blast radius.
- **Orphaned routes** (00034 `/account/subscription`, 00035 `/team`, 00036 `/workspace/members`) — confidence 0.65; could legitimately be WIP. Don't block; ask author.
- **Weak test** (00037 single weak matcher) — 00020 is the dangerous one; this is a follow-up.
- **TODOs in `billing.ts`** (00038, 12.9/kLOC, just over threshold) — noise compared to 00016.

## Decision

**Request changes.** The 7 BLOCK items split cleanly into three quick fixes (00007, 00008, 00009 — env coupling + ambiguous date parse), two correctness families that should be addressed at the source (00002+00003 in date.ts), and two safety/honesty items (00020 false-green test, 00021 misleading function name). None require structural work; all can land in this PR. The WARN tier can become follow-ups, with a strong preference for bundling 00015+00017 (nav/route alignment) and 00026+00005 (split `billing.ts` while extracting `generateInvoice`).
